title: Finite-type submodule on the union with one affine open
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $W$ a quasi-compact open [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], $V$ an affine open, and $H$ a quasi-coherent module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, pqf-def-coherent] such that $H|_W$ is of finite type [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation]. Put $U=W\cup V$. There is a quasi-coherent finite-type module $G$ on $U$, with a monomorphism $\varphi:G\to H|_U$ whose restriction to $W$ is an isomorphism. Only a module on $U$ is constructed; no extension outside $U$ is asserted.

proof.text: The overlap W intersect V is quasi-compact by quasi-separatedness and compactness of affine opens. Identify H restricted to V with the tilde of its global sections N. Cover the overlap by finitely many principal affine opens D(f_i), on each of which N localized at f_i is finitely generated.

proof.text: Take the finitely generated submodule N-prime of N spanned by the numerators of those localized generators. Its tilde is quasi-coherent and finite type. The localized inclusion is surjective because it contains each chosen generator, and injective by localization of a submodule. Thus the associated sheaf inclusion is an isomorphism on every D(f_i), and hence on the overlap by the sheaf property.

proof.text: Glue this submodule on V with H restricted to W. On an open T of W union V, impose membership in both submodules after restriction to the two intersections. The equal overlap restrictions make this a subsheaf with the prescribed restrictions. Quasi-coherence and finite type are local.

lean.statement: theorem exists_finiteType_affine_union (X : Scheme.{u}) [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] (W : X.Opens) (hW : IsCompact (W : Set X)) (V : X.affineOpens) (H : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) [H.IsQuasicoherent] [(H.over W).IsFiniteType] : ∃ G : SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over (W ⊔ V.1)), G.IsQuasicoherent ∧ G.IsFiniteType ∧ ∃ (φ : G ⟶ H.over (W ⊔ V.1)), Mono φ ∧ IsIso ((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (homOfLE (show W ≤ W ⊔ V.1 from le_sup_left))).map φ)
